title: Globally filtered clone raw instance
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with template $\Psi$ and variables $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement. Suppose $r\le M$ and every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. The globally filtered clone raw CSP instance over $V\times\mathrm{Fin}(M)$ consists of one constraint for each globally filtered clone occurrence, and its multiset of constraints is nonempty.
